outcome.failed: Could not send for signing — needs attention

approval.notifyNoRecipient: Nobody receives the notification for step {{name}} — choose recipients in Company › Processes

reason.closedDeclined: Someone already rejected or sent it back
reason.passedOwner: {{name}} approved on their behalf (full rights) at {{at}}
reason.skipped: The step's condition is not met
reason.running: The system is working on it

next.pending: {{who}} will be notified when it is their turn
next.pendingAnon: Moves on automatically when it is its turn
next.openMe: You need to: Approve, Return for edits or Reject
next.openOther: Waiting for {{who}}; nothing for you to do yet
next.openOtherAnon: Waiting for the approver; nothing for you to do yet
next.returned: The drafter edits and sends it again
next.rejected: The contract stops; the owner can reopen it
next.running: Nothing to do, wait for it to finish
next.failed: The owner presses Retry or Reopen process
next.closed: The step is decided; nothing for you to do

reason.pending: E-signing starts once approval is done
reason.sending: The system is sending the document
reason.sent: The document was sent to all signers
reason.sentNoDue: Sent to all signers; no signing deadline

next.pending: Sent for signature automatically, nothing for you to do
next.sent: Waiting for signers; nothing for you to do yet
next.resend: Fix the cause above, then press Resend
next.owner: The contract owner handles it (Resend or Reopen the process)

reason.NO_PARTNER_EMAIL: The partner has no email. Add one in the partner details, then press Resend.
reason.NO_SIGNER: No company signer is set. Choose one in Company › Processes, then press Resend.
reason.SEND_FAILED: The e-signature service did not receive the document. Check {{path:flow}}, then press Resend.
reason.DECLINED: A signer declined. Ask them, edit the contract if needed, then press Resend.
reason.VOIDED: The signing request was voided. Press Resend to create a new one.

esign.stillBlocked: Not sent yet: fix the cause shown on the e-signature step, then press Resend.
esign.resendFail: Could not resend because the e-signature service did not answer. Try again in a few minutes; if it persists, ask a company admin to check {{path:flow}}.

file.failed: Could not upload the file. Choose it again (PDF, image, Word, Excel, text; up to 20 MB).

form.failed: Could not submit the form. Try again.
